title: 修复改名后的本机解析：仅追加批准hosts映射，保留别名和原sudo策略
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 对照内核主机名、getent hosts 本机名和 nsswitch hosts 顺序，核实本地主机映射是否仍使用旧名。
按发行版主机命名规范修正权威配置和本地映射，保留必要别名；无需停用全部 DNS。
验证本机名解析和 sudo 响应，若仍慢再分离目录认证等路径。

conversion.original_title: 主机改名后每次 sudo 都等待并提示 unable to resolve host，其他域名解析正常。如何定位？

body:
## 操作任务
实现repair_hosts(text,hostname,address)，输出完整hosts新文本，不写宿主文件。hostname是当前获批主机名（DNS标签语法、每标签1–63字符、全长≤253、不以点结尾），address是本教学实例批准的IPv4 loopback。若活跃记录已把该名字映射到批准地址，原文逐字返回；如有冲突/坏地址则ValueError并停止，不覆盖其他管理员记录；否则仅在末尾补一行address hostname及必要换行。注释中的名字不算有效映射。大小写不敏感，保留全部原别名、IPv6、其他服务映射、注释与行序。拒绝换行注入、非loopback及无效名字，不重命名机器，不修改sudoers、secure_path、DNS默认配置或业务身份。普通非root判分检查精确最小改动；独立可信补充在自有容器里实际运行sudo -n -l和NSS，记录修复前后解析告警，不向学生开放特权工具。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
本题基础判分是非root文本变更合同；真实sudo/NSS另有绑定原题指纹的独立可信原生补充。补充只操作随机标记自有临时容器的可丢弃/etc/hosts和私有sudo工具策略，不操作宿主。sudo策略读取器为内部临时UID切换需要SETUID/SETGID两项能力；其余cap丢弃、no-new-privileges、无网络/设备/宿主挂载、非privileged，不构建或提交镜像。实际验证sudo -l告警消失及原root策略清单不变，不声称普通用户PAM登录、任意命令授权或真实DNS长延迟全部验收；保留宿主默认身份与权限。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,hashlib
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: approved hostname NSS hosts repair",flush=True)
source="# managed records preserved\n127.0.0.1 localhost\n::1 localhost ip6-localhost\n127.0.1.1 old-name old-alias # keep\n192.0.2.17 db.internal database\n# opsforge-renamed is not an active mapping\n"
fixed=task.repair_hosts(source,"opsforge-renamed","127.0.1.1")
assert fixed==source+"127.0.1.1 opsforge-renamed\n","missing hostname was not minimally appended"
assert task.repair_hosts(fixed,"opsforge-renamed","127.0.1.1")==fixed,"idempotent repair changed existing aliases"
assert task.repair_hosts("127.0.1.1 OPSFORGE-renamed old\n","opsforge-renamed","127.0.1.1")=="127.0.1.1 OPSFORGE-renamed old\n"
assert task.repair_hosts("127.0.0.1 localhost","edge.example","127.0.0.2")=="127.0.0.1 localhost\n127.0.0.2 edge.example\n"
assert task.repair_hosts("","edge","127.0.0.2")=="127.0.0.2 edge\n"
def reject(text,host,address):
 try:task.repair_hosts(text,host,address)
 except ValueError:return
 raise AssertionError("unsafe or conflicting mapping accepted")
for host in ["bad name","bad\n127.0.0.1 injected","-start","trailing-","a..b","a"*64,"a.b."]:
 reject(source,host,"127.0.1.1")
for address in ["192.0.2.8","::1","127.0.1.1\ninvalid","not-an-ip"]:
 reject(source,"opsforge-renamed",address)
for text in ["192.0.2.9 opsforge-renamed\n","127.0.1.1 opsforge-renamed\n192.0.2.9 opsforge-renamed\n","bad-ip opsforge-renamed\n"]:
 reject(text,"opsforge-renamed","127.0.1.1")
print("NATIVE_SUDO_HOSTNAME_PLAN_APPEND_ONLY_IDEMPOTENT_PRESERVE_ALIASES_IPV6_NEIGHBORS_AND_CONFLICT_REJECTION",flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
